trainingData.value: 20 trillion text tokens pretraining, then long-context extension and post-training (SFT, RL, MOPD); datasets released on HuggingFace

source.quote:
We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Ultra on 20 trillion text
tokens, then extended the context length to 1M tokens, and post-trained using Supervised Fine Tuning
(SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD).

topics.headline: SFT safety blend with policy-mapped prompts and policy-compliant responses (~135K multilingual samples)

source.quote:
Safety. To instill robust safety behaviors, first, we retain the 45K safety data blend curated
in Nemotron 3 Super (NVIDIA, 2026) with prompts curated from diverse sources and responses
synthetically generated conditioned on a response policy mapped to each prompt.

topics.headline: Agentic Safety Teacher targets indirect prompt injection in tool-response content across four attack categories

source.quote:
Agentic Safety Teacher. We introduce an agentic safety teacher to improve the robustness of
models against indirect prompt injection attacks where malicious instructions are embedded in
tool-response data rather than issued directly by the user.

topics.headline: Highest [AA-Omniscience](/evals/aa-omniscience) non-hallucination score (78.7) among compared open models; abstention training for hallucination reduction

source.quote:
On AA-Omniscience, Nemotron 3
Ultra achieves the highest non-hallucination score, 78.7, suggesting a favorable reliability profile and
a lower tendency to produce unsupported answers when knowledge is uncertain.

topics.headline: Ultra-based GenRM scaled to mitigate reward hacking during reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)

source.quote:
Generative Reward Models (GenRM) (Wang et al., 2025c)
with reasoning capabilities help mitigate such reward hacking behaviors, but substantial failure
cases still remain.

findings.text: Nemotron 3 Ultra leads the open-model comparison on [AA-Omniscience](/evals/aa-omniscience) non-hallucination at 78.7, while several larger peers score in the single digits.
An Agentic Safety Teacher uses automated red-teaming (Nemotron 3 Super attacker, Nemotron 3 Nano defender) for verifiable indirect prompt-injection resistance.

source.quote:
To generate challenging attacks, we use an automated red-teaming loop in which an attacker model
iteratively rewrites the injected instruction against a defender model until the defender follows it and
only successful attacks are retained.

findings.text: The final multilingual safety supervised fine-tuning (SFT) blend is about 135K samples (about 45K English plus about 15K each in six translated languages).

source.quote:
The final safety
blend contains about ≈ 135K samples: ≈ 45K in English and ≈ 15K from each of the translated
languages.

findings.text: NVFP4 quantization lowers OmniScience Non-Hallucination from 78.7 (BF16) to 75.5.
Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) training raises OmniScience Non-Hallucination from 4.8 (SFT) to 78.7 (MOPD2), closing most of the gap to the specialized teacher (87.0).
